en.headline: Hang Seng slips below 25,000 as financials weigh
en.dek: The benchmark was down about 186 points, or 0.7 per cent, near 24,902 in late morning trade, after opening just above the 25,000 mark.
body: Hong Kong stocks fell below the 25,000-point level on Wednesday morning, ending a short run of gains as financial and technology shares came under selling pressure.

Hang Seng Indexes Company data updated at 10.52am showed the Hang Seng Index at 24,901.76, down 185.99 points or 0.74 per cent from Tuesday's close of 25,087.75. The day's range by then ran from 24,836.16 to 25,072.25. The index had opened around 25,065.

Local reports said Chinese financial names and several large technology stocks were among the weaker spots, while the properties sub-index was firmer. Turnover in the early session was modest by recent standards.

The figures are mid-session readings and can change before the close. Investors were watching mainland markets and overnight cues from Wall Street as the local market worked through the Mid-Autumn holiday week.

zh.headline: 恒指失守25000點 金融股拖累早段跌約186點
zh.dek: 恒生指數公司上午10時52分數據顯示，恒指報24901點，跌186點或0.74%，早市高見25072、低見24836。
body: 港股周三早段失守25000點關口，結束連升走勢，金融及部分科技股偏軟。
恒生指數公司上午10時52分更新的數據顯示，恒生指數報24901.76點，較周二收市25087.75點跌185.99點，跌幅0.74%。當日高低位分別為25072.25及24836.16。指數低開後一度守在25000點之上，其後跌穿關口。
本地財經報道指中資金融股及部分大型科技股沽壓較明顯，地產分類指數則相對堅挺。早段成交未見特別活躍。
以上為午市前數據，收市前仍會變動。投資者繼續留意內地股市及隔夜外圍表現，本周亦踏入中秋假期前的交易時段。
